Overview.value: Five transport modes with eight destinations each
Packaged roster; availability may be gated
Five mode income nodes and three stage income nodes
Proxy model; continuous online; max each route before advancing
Same strategy; alternate packaged upgrade costs
No Android runtime playthrough or account telemetry
No general research, ads, events, gem rewards or paid boosts
Route costs are extracted; throughput and playtime are approximations

Playtime.value: Cadence conversion assumes evenly spaced sessions and frozen income between visits.
It is an illustrative conversion, not a simulated calendar completion time.

Route balance.value: Source: k52.java and pv7.java from supplied APK. Cash values are in game currency.

Upgrade calculator.value: 1 Current  2 New  Amber cells are editable
Source: kk0.a and z46.x. No research discounts or prestige cost multiplier.
Level 30 next cost is 0 because the card is capped. Game rounding uses Math.rint.
At exact .5 ties, Excel ROUND may differ from game ties to even.

Research.value: Source: jx5.java. Repeatable node prices and timers use zx5 and ay5 formulas; base is not first price.

Managers.value: Source: xf4.java. 21 Common, 15 Rare, 15 Epic, 15 Legendary and 5 Mythic definitions.
